jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction name. With date (or year) and office it forms the contest id used in output file names; empty parts are skipped.

office.description: Office being elected. Used in the contest id. Not passed to the parser; parsers that need an office take it through extra_parser_args.

year.description: Election year. Used in the contest id only when date is empty.

date.description: Election date, mm/dd/yyyy. Used in the contest id; year is used instead when date is empty.

notes.description: Free text stored with the contest.

ignore_contest.description: Skip this row when running the batch.

cvr_path.description: CVR file, or directory for parsers that read a folder, relative to cvr_path_root in run_config.json.

parser_func.description: Parser for the CVR file format. One of the functions registered in parsers.py.

extra_parser_args.description: Additional parser arguments as key=value pairs separated by semicolons, e.g. office=Mayor;filter_column=BallotStyleID.

rcv_type.description: Tabulation variant: SingleWinner, Sequential, Until2, STVWholeBallot, STVFractionalBallot, or BottomsUpThresh.

writeins_eliminated_first.description: Eliminate the write-in candidate in the first elimination round regardless of its vote total.

n_winners.description: Number of seats. Used by multi-winner variants only.

multi_winner_rounds.description: In STV, elect every candidate over the threshold in the same round. If false, elect only the one with the most votes and continue.

bottoms_up_threshold.description: Fraction of active votes, between 0 and 1, a candidate needs to be elected in a round. Defaults to 1/(n_winners+1).

truncate_to.description: Decimal places that fractional surplus transfer weights are truncated to.

exhaust_on_overvote_marks.description: Exhaust a ballot at its first overvote (more than one candidate at one rank). If false, the overvoted rank is skipped.

exhaust_on_N_repeated_skipped_marks.description: Exhaust a ballot after this many consecutive skipped rankings. 0 means skipped rankings never exhaust.

exhaust_on_duplicate_candidate_marks.description: Exhaust a ballot at the first rank that repeats a candidate already ranked above. If false, the repeat is skipped.

combine_writein_marks.description: Combine all write-in candidates into one. A candidate named UWI, or whose name contains 'write', counts as a write-in.

treat_combined_writeins_as_exhaustable_d.description: When write-ins are combined, two write-in marks on one ballot count as a duplicate ranking for the exhaustion rule.

split_fields.description: CVR column names, comma-separated, to compute statistics per value of. Needs the split_stats output.
